title: ROOF Roadster Classic Matte Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Roof Roadster Classic Matte Black pairs retro roadster charm with modern multi-density cranial protection, pairing 180-degree panoramic sightlines with certified cranial protection. Built around a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell weighing a featherweight 1111g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~97 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across ECE 22.06 benchmarks. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Round Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Heritage open-face with goggles for cafe racer and scrambler riders.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Optimized for Round Oval head shapes with pressure-relief temple channels and contoured removable cheek pads.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.

Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Roof's Open Face lineup, the ROOF Roadster Classic Matte Black brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Round Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Roof Roadster Classic Matte Black represents Roof's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~97 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Open Face helmet tailored to a Round Oval head shape, the Roof Roadster Classic Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
